Through everyone's united efforts, the Abyssal calamity in the north seems to have been quelled...
The day of triumph draws near.

#### View Letter

#### Go to Starsnatch Cliff

**Venti:** Ah, welcome back, old friend. And how should I be addressing you these days? The Honorary Knight of Mondstadt? The "Tumaini" of Natlan? Or the great hero of Nod-Krai?

- **Traveler:** Just call me by my name...

**Paimon:** Wow, you sure have your finger on the pulse... We've barely caught our breath since Nod-Krai, but it sounds like you've already heard about what went down.

**Venti:** Heh, news travels fast on the wind. But before I can turn your tales into tunes, I need to hear them from the horse's mouth.

**Venti:** My wine and my lyre are at the ready. So please, Traveler, take a seat and tell me your tale.

You tell Venti everything that happened in Nod-Krai...

**Venti:** ...Amazing, incredible! The Rächer of Solnari and The Doctor... Truly a tale for the ages!

**Venti:** So I'm guessing the Wild Hunt is a thing of the past now that you've defeated the Rächer of Solnari?

**Paimon:** Seems that way... We were kinda focused on dealing with The Doctor, though.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** There are still some vestiges of the Wild Hunt around...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** But not enough to pose a major threat.

##### Shared continuation

**Venti:** Well, that's good to hear. Hey, now that the Northern Abyss Calamity is finally resolved, Varka must be getting ready for the triumphant return of his expedition, right?

**Venti:** I haven't seen him in the longest time... He must have so many stories to share.

- **Traveler:** I was gonna ask... You two have really met before?

**Paimon:** Right, Paimon was wondering about that too! He did call you Barbatos... But weren't you still fast asleep back when he was in Mondstadt?

**Venti:** Umm... Let's call it half-asleep. I was resting my eyes in the Thousand Winds Temple one day when I heard a commotion outside...

**Venti:** It was a young knight, who had journeyed there in search of trials and oracles after hearing some tall tales at the local tavern...

**Venti:** In fact, all that awaited him were moss-covered walls and an angry Ruin Guard. But he seemed completely unfazed, laughing heartily as he sent the Ruin Guard's missiles flying off into the horizons...

**Paimon:** They must have been making quite a racket if it was enough to wake up the Tone-Deaf Bard...

**Venti:** Yeah... It sounded kinda like...

**Ruin Guard:** BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!

**???:** Hey! Is that all you've got?

**???:** Bring it on! Hahaha!

**Venti:** ...Like that...

**???:** Giving up already? Hey, you're not half as tough as Varka said.

**Venti:** A young Knight of Favonius, trekking out to the Thousand Winds Temple in search of adventure... Now there's a sight I haven't seen in a while.

**???:** Hmm? A bard in green clothes... Does this mean... you're Venti?

**???:** Hah! I was just wondering how I was gonna track you down.

**Paimon:** Oh... So you were looking for the Tone-Deaf Bard? Strange place to start your search...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** I would have tried the Angel's Share...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** I would have gone to The Cat's Tail...

##### Shared continuation

**???:** Hold on — blond hair, white hair... You must be the Honorary Knight and Paimon? The Grand Master talks about you all the time.

**Lohen:** Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Lohen, Vice Captain of the 5th Company of the Knights of Favonius and a member of the expeditionary force. Pleased to make your acquaintance.

**Paimon:** Ohhh, so you're part of the expedition, huh? Right, so that's why Paimon's never seen you around in Mondstadt... Hey, wait a second! We never saw you in Nod-Krai, either!

**Lohen:** That's probably because when the Wild Hunt was still running rampant, I spent most of my time out on my own, making mincemeat out of monsters. I barely went back to base at all.

**Lohen:** Then, once the Wild Hunt calmed down, I got sent back to Mondstadt... Mixed blessing, if you ask me. Sounds like I missed out on some serious action.

**Paimon:** No wonder we never saw you while we were dealing with The Doctor... So, why did Varka send you back?

- **Traveler:** Don't tell me he sent you to—

**Lohen:** Deliver some letters.

- **Traveler:** ...I was gonna say deliver a letter...

**Lohen:** There's one for the Knights of Favonius, one for the church, another for the Dawn Winery... At least ten of them in total.

**Paimon:** Geez... How many people has he sent to deliver his mail now? Mika, Ineffa, Lohen... He should just hire a full-time mailman already!

**Paimon:** In fact, he's earned himself a new nickname. Let's go with... Sir Writes-A-Lot!

- **Traveler:** Another day, another nickname, huh, Tone-Deaf Bard?

**Venti:** Hehe, I'll have you know that poetry and letters were humanity's earliest means of expressing their thoughts.

**Venti:** So, tone-deaf or not, I wear the title of bard with pride — and I consider "Sir Writes-A-Lot" to be quite a compliment.

**Paimon:** Wait, really? Darn it... Maybe Paimon should come up with some harder-hitting nicknames for these two...

**Venti:** Anyway... Since this young man has come all the way to the Thousand Winds Temple looking for me, I assume he must have a letter for me, too. Am I right?

**Lohen:** You sure are. To use the Grand Master's own words:

**Varka:** "This one is for the bard in green clothes. These days, I think he goes by... Venti?"

**Varka:** "Doesn't really have an address, as such... You could start by asking around in Mondstadt. Or maybe try your luck at the Thousand Winds Temple."

**Lohen:** I figured that since there was this punching bag here— oh sorry, "Ruin Guard," I could get some practice in while I was at it. So, I came right here the second I got back to Mondstadt.

**Paimon:** That Varka is so slapdash sometimes... It's a good thing we happened to be nearby.

- **Traveler:** So? What does the letter say?

**Lohen:** Oh — he also said to remind you to write back.

**Venti:** ...Nothing in particular — just some idle chatter between two drinking buddies. But if I'm supposed to write back this time... Hmm, I'll need some time to mull over my response.

**Venti:** Varka gave you a whole bunch of letters to deliver, right? Maybe you can head into Mondstadt and deliver the rest of them first?

**Lohen:** My thoughts exactly. Assuming I can find the way... Hopefully the roads haven't changed too much since the pre-expedition days?

**Venti:** Well, why don't we have Mondstadt's Honorary Knight escort this homeward-bound wanderer to the city? I'm sure some of the recipients of Varka's letters will turn out to be old friends of yours too.

- **Traveler:** I have no objections...

**Paimon:** Let's go! It's been a while since Paimon's done any guide work!

**Lohen:** Thank you so much, Honorary Knight — and you, Miss Guide!

**Venti:** The Abyss... The Wild Hunt... Andrius...

**Venti:** ...Get home safe, Varka.

**Varka:** Hmm... Why do my ears feel so hot all of a sudden? Is someone talking about me...

#### Check the situation

#### Prepare for battle

**Varka:** ...Surely, there's no way anyone found the secret stash of cash in my office? That would be terrible...

**Winfried:** Grand Master! Bad time to get distracted!

**Ekbert:** Watch out! Enemies approaching!

**Varka:** Huh? Oh, it's just a few stragglers. They're no real threat to us.

**Varka:** This expedition is almost over. We just need to deal with these final few targets... and then...

**Varka:** We will make our triumphant return!

#### Defeat the Wild Hunt

#### Talk to the knights

**Winfried:** Without the Rächer of Solnari to direct them, it seems like all that's left is their primal urge to destroy.

**Ekbert:** If this is all that the Wild Hunt can muster now, surely the Lightkeepers of Nod-Krai will be able to deal with what's left?

**Varka:** (Just like I thought... What we should be wary of now, is—)

**Leifhelm:** Grand Master, based on Lightkeeper intel and our own reconnaissance, one of the suspected targets should be just up ahead.

**Varka:** Good. You know the drill — Stay here and stand guard. Leave the rest to me.

**Knights:** Yes, Grand Master!

**Varka:** ...We meet again, Andrius.

#### Face the Wolf Spirit

**Varka:** (Everything seems normal so far... Here's hoping I'm just overthinking things. There are two other places to check... Maybe this'll all go smoothly after all?)

**Varka:** ...It's your turn, my friend.

**Varka:** Come, Andrius.

**Wandering Knight:** ...Although if we're returning to your old home, perhaps "Andrius" is a little too ostentatious...

**Wandering Knight:** Hmm, might be better to go by...

**???:** ..."Boreas"?

**???:** ...Boreas.

**Varka:** ...!

**???:** ...Injustice, corruption, iniquity...

**???:** Is the surface world still as wretched and foul as ever?

**???:** Answer me, heir to the knighthood of Boreas.

**Varka:** Heh... Looks like I'm not getting out of this without a fight!

#### Read the Grand Master's letter together

**Varka:** "...That's where things stand with the expedition. The victors will be returning home soon — so make sure to stock up on wine for the celebrations!"

**Varka:** "P.S.: I hope everyone's keeping up with their daily training! I'll be testing you all when I get back to make sure no one's regressed."

**Varka & Lohen:** "P.P.S.: I wrote individual letters for each and every one of you. Don't forget to write back!" — That's all.

**Paimon:** Everyone gets one? Wow, Sir Writes-A-Lot is really living up to his name!

**Amber:** I guess the Grand Master must have something specific to say to each of us.

**Noelle:** Even I got a letter — and I'm not a real Knight yet...

**Jean:** ...

**Lisa:** ...Jean?

**Jean:** Oh... Yes, that's our Grand Master for you.

**Lohen:** By the way, anyone know where I can find the Cavalry Captain? I have a letter for him as well.

**Eula:** You mean, Kaeya? He said he was meeting a friend from the church at the Angel's Share.

**Eula:** Allegedly for work — said he was "exchanging intel." But I'd say there's a fifty-fifty chance he's just there for a drink.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** The Angel's Share...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Intelligence from the Church of Favonius?

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** Paimon bets there'll be lots of familiar faces there... How about we deliver Kaeya's letter? ...And these other two as well!

**Lohen:** Really? That would be a great help, thank you.

**Jean:** Our thanks to you too, Lohen. The other knights will help distribute the remaining letters. You've had a long journey — please, go get some rest.

**Lohen:** Great! But I won't be resting just yet. I have one last letter to deliver to Wolvendom. This one, I was planning on delivering personally.

**Lohen:** I heard that another challenger recently passed Boreas's trial? Well, with any luck, that wolf might be willing to reveal himself to me, too...

**Jean:** *sigh* ...Very well. But please remember to show respect to the local wolves.

**Lohen:** I will. Goodbye!

**Jean:** ...

- **Traveler:** (Clearly, something is bothering Jean. I should talk to her before going to the Angel's Share.)

#### Talk to Jean

**Jean:** Honorary Knight? You're still here?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** I'll be setting off shortly, but...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** It seems like there's something on your mind?

##### Shared continuation

**Jean:** ...Is it that obvious?

**Paimon:** Huh? But... Varka's coming back, the situation in Nod-Krai is stable... Surely things are looking up?

**Jean:** True. From what you and Lohen have told me, the expedition has indeed accomplished its strategic objectives.

**Jean:** It seems that Mondstadt no longer faces any threat from the perils of the North, be they the Wild Hunt or The Doctor.

**Jean:** And yet... For some reason, I can't help but recall something the Grand Master said to me before he left...

**Varka:** ...If I don't make it back from this expedition, you'll have to assume the mantle of Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius.

**Varka:** If it comes to that, remember to train the next Knight of Boreas in my stead.

**Varka:** I've planted some promising seeds in Mondstadt, but they still need time to grow.

**Varka:** Some have yet to master the art of social interaction, some don't yet understand that they, too, need protecting, and some... Well, some might not even want to be a knight yet.

**Varka:** ...What's wrong? Ah, there's no need to frown — I'm going on an expedition, not marching to my death! This is all just a contingency plan in the event that I'm unable to return.

**Varka:** Until I return, I leave them in your care.

**Jean:** ...The lineage of the Knights of Boreas has nearly been extinguished twice in Mondstadt's history.

**Jean:** The first wandering knight to claim the title arrived in Mondstadt a thousand years ago, along with his wolf companion.

**Jean:** He was as free as the wind. He left no succession plan behind — even his name was lost to history. The title of "Boreas" could have disappeared from Mondstadt just as he did...

**Jean:** But he had an informal disciple — a knight named Ravenwood, who admired the Knight of Boreas greatly. Ravenwood's valor and swordsmanship earned him the Wolf Spirit's recognition...

**Jean:** ...When the old aristocracy tried to regain power, Ravenwood came once more to Mondstadt's defense. From then on, the title of Knight of Boreas was passed down from generation to generation within the Knights of Favonius.

**Paimon:** "Wolf Spirit"... You mean that big blue wolf in Wolvendom?

**Jean:** Correct. As you may already know, the Wo(Boreas)lf of the North is the surviving spirit of an ancie(Andrius)nt god.

**Jean:** And the Knight of Boreas serves as an intermediary between him and humanity.

**Jean:** "Lupus Boreas, who had never known what it meant to love, came to understand it through the journey with his human companion. In the end, he chose to allow his power to become one with the land..."

**Jean:** This was once a well-known tale in Mondstadt. But these days, few people are aware that the starting point of the Wolf King's journey was not Mondstadt, but Nod-Krai.

**Paimon:** ...Huh!?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** (Could it be...)

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** (He set off from the royal court of the Seelie...)

**Jean:** You don't seem surprised... Did you sense something in Nod-Krai? Once again, you do us proud, Honorary Knight.

##### Shared continuation

**Jean:** The Great Wolf King of the North came here from Nod-Krai... Although, he doesn't like to speak of his past. In fact, he rarely shows himself to people at all nowadays.

**Jean:** As such, this tale can only be found deep within the Knights of Favonius Library. Even among the Knights of Favonius, few are aware of it.

**Jean:** The Grand Master didn't disclose any concrete objectives before departing on his expedition. I couldn't help but wonder whether it might somehow be related to Nod-Krai's Wolf of the North...

**Jean:** I kept my speculations to myself, however. Sharing them would only spread unwarranted suspicion toward The Four Winds among the people of Mondstadt.

**Jean:** You experienced the turmoil caused by Dvalin, the East Wind's actions for yourself. Surely you can understand my concern?

**Paimon:** No wonder Varka wasn't clear about his motives... Is that what he was worried about?

**Jean:** Very possibly. He was probably also reserving judgment. Having heard about your experiences in Nod-Krai, I now suspect that the Grand Master hadn't yet ascertained the true identity of our enemy at that time.

**Jean:** And as it turns out, the Calamity Born in the North wasn't an ancient god, but rather the Wild Hunt and The Doctor... I guess we were both jumping to conclusions.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Well, always better to be overprepared than caught off guard.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Facing the worst-case scenario with no backup plan would have been far worse.

##### Shared continuation

**Jean:** Yes, I completely agree. The tide can turn rapidly in times of battle. It's a leader's responsibility to prepare for every possible contingency.

**Jean:** Even if his contingency plan never needs to be put into action, I'm sure the Grand Master is relieved to know that it's in place.

#### Leave the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

#### Go to the Angel's Share

**Amber:** Okay, we'll deliver these letters to the Adventurers' Guild and The Cat's Tail! You can just handle the ones for the Angel's Share.

**Mika:** Phew... The expedition is finally wrapping up. I hope the maps I made on our way there are good enough to get them safely home.

**Eula:** He wants to test me to see if my skills have regressed? Hmph, I still haven't forgotten how he went easy on me last time!

**Eula:** I'm assuming you must have seen him going all out before? When the time comes, you'd better keep an eye on him for me!

**Kaeya:** "When you're mixing drinks in hot weather, start by pouring in cold water, and add ice cubes, then drain out the water before adding the other ingredients." How's that for a secret recipe? Maybe it's worth a little intel in return?

**Rosaria:** *scoff* Please, I've known that little trick for a good ten years at least. You'll have to offer something a little more substantial if you're serious about trading.

**Diluc:** I know there's no one else in the tavern right now, but do you two really need to talk so loudly? Especially if you're supposed to be exchanging confidential information.

**Paimon:** Kaeya! Rosaria! Diluc! Paimon knew we'd find you here!

**Diluc:** ...Looks like it's about to get even noisier.

**Kaeya:** Haha, a little liveliness never killed anyone. Traveler, Paimon, what brings you our way?

- **Traveler:** I have a letter for each of you...

You deliver Varka's letters to their recipients...

**Varka:** "...Please allow me to once again express my sincere condolences regarding your late father and the incident with Eroch. We make absolutely no excuse for his crimes."

**Varka:** "...I hope you will give some serious consideration to the question I asked you before I left — though I'm sure you're tired of hearing me ask by now. The Knights of Favonius will always welcome you."

**Diluc:** Hmph…

**Kaeya:** From the look on your face, I'm guessing the Grand Master is still refusing to drop it?

**Rosaria:** He nags like an old man. It's hardly surprising.

**Paimon:** Huh? Drop what? What's this about?

**Diluc:** Nothing, really. Before leaving on the expedition, Varka came here to chat with me over a drink. I failed to avoid him.

**Diluc:** He asked me if I'd consider rejoining the Knights of Favonius, and I declined. He expressed his regret about everything that happened and asked me to reconsider. That's all there is to it.

**Paimon:** Yeah, right... Sounds like you skipped a lot of details. There's clearly more to it!

**Diluc:** Whatever details I chose to omit are in the past. Dragging them back up now serves no purpose.

**Kaeya:** You say that now, but back then, you couldn't let it go. You and the Knights of Favonius were constantly at odds.

**Diluc:** ...I wasn't seeing the full picture. I've had a lot of time to reflect since then.

**Diluc:** But my answer remains unchanged — I'm not rejoining the Knights of Favonius.

**Diluc:** Both the Grand Master and the Acting Grand Master are too upright and honorable.

**Diluc:** They can't see the shadows that lurk beneath them due to the size of the organization they lead... They need someone on the outside to keep watch vigilantly.

**Kaeya:** If I had a Mora for every time I've heard you repeat that argument... I actually don't disagree with the first part of what you said. But don't you think someone can keep tabs on things from the inside?

**Rosaria:** When you join an organization, you're bound by its rules, no matter how free it may seem on the surface.

**Kaeya:** You think so? Never mind the Knights... Have you honestly ever been bound by the rules of the Church?

**Rosaria:** Good question. Have you considered that maybe, that's why I chose to join the church and not the Knights to begin with?

**Paimon:** Um... Traveler, are they arguing or not? It's kinda hard to tell...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** They're not arguing.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** They just have different ways of protecting those around them.

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** Ohh... Kinda like the "contingencies" Jean was talking about? The more ways they have to protect their home, the better! ...Huh? Traveler?

- **Traveler:** (I wonder if... this is exactly what Varka was hoping for?)

**Noelle:** The Grand Master offered lots of advice in his letter regarding my recent assessments... I didn't think he'd spare a thought for that kind of thing in the middle of an expedition.

**Noelle:** So, um... Honorary Knight, if you have the time... do you think you could help me out with my special training?

**Jean:** Thank you for being such a patient listener. I feel much more settled after talking with you.

**Jean:** If you have any spare time, would you mind stopping off to say hello to the other knights? I'm sure they have all missed our Honorary Knight just as much as I have.

**Lisa:** Ah, the Grand Master... The archives are filled with documents awaiting his review. I'm not letting him run off again until he's finished dealing with every last one.

**Lisa:** On another note... have you spoken to Jean? I hope she'll finally be able to relax a little once Varka returns.

**Sucrose:** The Grand Master wrote in his letter that the Boom Blossom Bombs we sent worked really well — he wants to know if we've made any more...

**Klee:** Uncle Varka's coming home? Yay! I can't wait to go outside and play with him!

#### Talk to everyone

**Kaeya:** What should I report back to the Grand Master on? Let me think...

**Kaeya:** Public order inside the city, monster activity in the wild... oh, and a review of the latest vintages. Haha, I think I'll leave it at that.

#### Talk to everyone

**Diluc:** My reply won't be a long one — as usual. I'm sure Varka won't be surprised.

#### Talk to everyone

**Rosaria:** If you hadn't had to deliver that guy's mail, you wouldn't have been subjected to all this tedious arguing. When I write back, I'll tell him to quit making trouble for other people.

**Paimon:** It's no trouble! Lohen did most of the work. We just volunteered to do the last leg of the journey — mostly so we could come say hello!

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Besides, I wouldn't really call that an argument.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** You just have different ideas on how to protect Mondstadt.

##### Shared continuation

**Rosaria:** Heh... So you see what's really going on here. All three of us fell for that old rascal's scheme far too readily.

**Paimon:** Huh? Scheme? What do you mean? Was Varka lying in his letters, then?

**Rosaria:** No. While I'm sure Varka knows full well that Diluc would never agree to rejoin the knights, I believe the sentiments he expressed were genuine, as was his offer to welcome Diluc back.

**Rosaria:** There are people like Kaeya and I... and then there are those who are true champions of justice to the core. Those people are the most susceptible to being driven to extremes by great upheaval... It's happened in Mondstadt before.

**Rosaria:** Not only that... But it happened to a Knight of Boreas. That'll really hit home for Varka — and that's why his nagging is even more persistent than usual.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** A champion of justice driven to extremes?

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** You're saying, that happened to a Knight of Boreas?

##### Shared continuation

**Rosaria:** Yeah... So no one's told you this before? The lineage of the Knights of Boreas has nearly been extinguished twice in history.... The first was at its inception. The second was the case I was alluding to.

**Paimon:** Oh! Wasn't Jean telling us about this? Wait, and then we got caught up talking about the expedition, and we never got around to the second time...

**Rosaria:** I happened to hear about it from Varka once when he was drinking and started yammering on. The second crisis in the Knights of Boreas lineage... It was five hundred years ago.

**Rosaria:** Although the Knights of Boreas are meant to be intermediaries between humans and wolves, in practice, very few of them have been truly recognized by Lupus Boreas over the past millennium.

**Rosaria:** Of those who have, the best known are the first Knight of Boreas, Ravenwood, the "Wolf Pup" Rostam, and... hmph... Varka himself.

**Rosaria:** But five hundred years ago, there was one who earned the respect of Boreas even before gaining the title.

**Rosaria:** He was a disciple of Rostam. They thought he would become the mightiest Knight of Boreas who ever lived...

**Rosaria:** He was the perfect knight. Righteous, principled... His name was Roland, the "Bloodstained Knight."

**Paimon:** Yikes... "Bloodstained Knight"? That sounds a little ominous...

**Rosaria:** Well, apparently his original title was the "White Knight."

**Rosaria:** But he lost countless comrades during the Abyssal calamity five hundred years ago... including his tutor and mentor, Rostam.

**Rosaria:** The endless bloodshed stained his sword and armor a crimson as deep as black, transforming the White Knight into the Bloodstained Knight.

**Rosaria:** After that, he threw himself completely into battling monsters, leaving Mondstadt and the Knights of Favonius behind. To this day... no one knows his final whereabouts.

**Rosaria:** It's hard to say whether the loss of an important figure in his life is what drove him to the point of obsession, or whether he was already too far gone to save.

**Rosaria:** But had he known that the Knights of Favonius would always welcome him back... perhaps things would have turned out differently.

**Rosaria:** So if you want my opinion... The reason why Varka keeps asking Diluc to rejoin, despite knowing that he'll never say yes, is to let him know: You are not alone.

**Rosaria:** ...Hmph. After all these years, he's still as persistent as ever. Just like how he used to be with me...

**Paimon:** Huh. Turns out Varka's a lot more thoughtful than he lets on... Paimon had the wrong idea about him.

**Paimon:** Anyway, there's still something about this whole Boreas business that Paimon isn't really getting. Wasn't Andrius a god in Mondstadt thousands of years in the past?

**Paimon:** If so, why did Jean say that Boreas and the Wandering Knight only arrived here just one thousand years ago? Plus, Paimon's super curious about what happened to Roland...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Shall we go get answers straight from the horse's — or wolf's — mouth?

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** We can meet up with Lohen in Wolvendom while we're at it.

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** That's a great idea! Jean said he hasn't been showing himself much lately, but he always seems happy to oblige whenever you show up! Let's go!

#### Go to Wolvendom

**Rosaria:** Let me guess... you're heading to Wolvendom next? Say hi to Razor for me.

**Rosaria:** Oh — but I'm not helping him write his response to Varka. He needs to learn to be independent.

#### Go to Wolvendom

#### Look around

**Paimon:** What's going on here? Was Wolvendom always like this? Paimon has a baaad feeling about this...

**Paimon:** The Wild Hunt!? What are they doing here!? ...Watch out!

#### Defeat the Wild Hunt

#### Investigate the area

**Paimon:** Traveler! Are you alright?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Stay alert!

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** There's still something nearby!

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** Oh no, what now? It better not be more Wild Hunt monsters...

**Lohen:** ...Huh?

- **Traveler:** ...Lohen?

**Paimon:** Phew... You scared Paimon stiff! She thought you were—

**Lohen:** Stop right there. Answer me this — the two letters I gave you, who were they for?

**Paimon:** Um... Two letters? Wasn't it three...?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** ...There were three.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Kaeya, Diluc, and Rosaria.

##### Shared continuation

**Lohen:** Okay... Well, Paimon's clueless, naive expression doesn't appear to be an act...

**Paimon:** Hey! What are you trying to say... Wait, what are you trying to say, huh? Huh!?

- **Traveler:** He's saying, you passed the test.

**Paimon:** Paimon passed a test? Really!? She didn't even realize she was taking one...

**Boreas:** You may dispense with your suspicions. The wolf pack has borne witness — they fought against the aberrations that encroached upon this land, and our attackers showed no ability to disguise themselves this time.

**Boreas:** Ah, a familiar scent... Come, I will await you at the usual grounds.

**Lohen:** Well, if the boss of Wolvendom has vouched for you... I guess I should apologize for doubting you just now.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** It always pays to remain vigilant.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Were you attacked by the Wild Hunt, too?

##### Shared continuation

**Lohen:** Sure was. Fortunately, my experience in Nod-Krai didn't go to waste — turns out the Wild Hunt all feel the same when you stab them... They didn't stand a chance.

**Lohen:** Something seems wrong with that old wolf, though... Go on, you should check on him.

#### Go to Wolvendom

#### Go deeper into Wolvendom
